title: Escriba-OCR: A 1B Vision-Language Model for Error-Preserving Transcription of Handwritten Portuguese Essays
abstract: arXiv:2611.29874v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Feedback tools and research on learner writing need transcriptions of handwritten essays that keep exactly what the student wrote: misspellings, line breaks, struck-through words and insertions. Vision-language models (VLMs) read handwriting well, but they also tend to rewrite it into correct language. We measure this on BRESSAY, 1,000 handwritten Brazilian Portuguese essays, with a benchmark that adds error preservation, invented errors, edit-markup precision and recall and line structure to the character error rate (CER) and uses paired bootstrap confidence intervals. We restrict the study to open-weight models that schools can run on their own hardware. Of 22 open baselines, the best, Qwen3-VL 235B-A22B, reaches 5.6% CER on the 199 test pages; none reproduces the edit markup reliably, and every VLM replaces 39-78% of the words absent from a Portuguese dictionary with dictionary words. translated_title: Escriba-OCR：一个用于葡萄牙语手写作文错误保留转录的10亿参数视觉语言模型
translated_abstract: 反馈工具和学习者写作研究需要能够精确保留学生原文的手写作文转录：包括拼写错误、换行、划掉的词以及插入的内容。视觉语言模型（VLM）虽然能很好地识别手写文字，但也倾向于将原文改写为正确的语言。我们在BRESSAY数据集（包含1,000篇手写的巴西葡萄牙语作文）上对这一现象进行了测量，该基准测试在字符错误率（CER）的基础上增加了错误保留率、虚构错误、编辑标记的精确率与召回率以及行结构等指标，并使用配对自助法置信区间。我们将研究限定于学校可在自有硬件上运行的开源权重模型。在22个开源基线模型中，表现最佳的Qwen3-VL 235B-A22B在199个测试页面上达到了5.6%的CER；但没有一个模型能可靠地重现编辑标记，且每个VLM都会将39%-78%的葡萄牙语词典外词汇替换为词典中的词。我们在647个训练页面上对LightOnOCR-3-1B进行了微调……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了Escriba-OCR——一个10亿参数的视觉语言模型，通过在647页手写作文上微调，实现了葡萄牙语手写作文的错误保留转录，能够精确保留拼写错误、编辑标记和行结构，克服了现有开源模型倾向“自动纠错”的缺陷。
